_comment: The SERVER-OWNED suggested-prompt registry for the P5-T06 chat widget.
This file is the #375 boundary made concrete. That decision says no
ARBITRARY USER PROSE reaches the LLM provider while
ncollection_ai.enable_free_text_questions is off — and these prompts are
the opposite of arbitrary user prose: fixed English, reviewed in this
file, resolved server-side FROM THE KEY ALONE. The client sends a key;
the text it maps to never leaves this file's control. Editing this file
is editing what can be sent, which is exactly where that decision wants
the control surface to live (same philosophy as the #62 model whitelist).
Every question is drawn from the ANSWERABLE tier of
data/sample_questions.json — the P5-T03 review corpus — because a
suggestion the default context cannot answer teaches users the assistant
is broken. The stock.picking set is deliberately finance-flavoured: the
default context carries no inventory sections (that is a documented
P5-T03 boundary), and offering 'What is in stock?' would promise an
answer the pipeline cannot give. Grow these lists when the context
builder grows sections, not before.
modules maps an Odoo res_model (the widget reports where the user is)
to the prompt keys shown first. Unknown or missing contexts fall back
to 'default' server-side.
NOTE for dev/staging: this file is read ONCE per Odoo process
(models/chat.py caches it at import). After editing it, RESTART the
odoo container — a `make upgrade` alone re-reads XML/CSV data, not
Python-level caches, and would leave the old prompts being served.
